tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background on every screen. Cool off-white, not pure white, to cut sun glare on site.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, update entries, sheets and inputs that sit on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: photo placeholders, read-only values, the track behind the day counter.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders (3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and every `*-soft` tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: names, floors, captions, helper text, on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: scrub
tokens.usage: Brand colour, named for the OT. Primary action, selected state, links, and the critical-zone marker. As text on the surfaces and `scrub-soft`.

tokens.name: scrub-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `scrub` text: critical-zone tags, the selected row.

tokens.name: on-scrub
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `scrub` fill (the primary button's label).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Attention: something will go wrong if nobody acts (an order-by date tomorrow, a quiet site). Text on the surfaces and `signal-soft`; always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `signal` text: attention tags and rows.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Overdue or escalated: a missed order-by date, an alert not acknowledged in 24h. Text on the surfaces and `alert-soft`; always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: alert-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `alert` text: overdue tags and rows.

tokens.name: on-alert
tokens.usage: Text on an `alert` fill (the Escalate button).

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: General-zone marker: reception, waiting, interiors. Warm against `scrub`'s cool, so the two zones read apart. Text on the surfaces and `stone-soft`.

tokens.name: stone-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `stone` text: general-zone tags.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 3:1 or better on all surfaces.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the project name on a project's home and the doctor report header.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: All running text and update notes. Never smaller on a phone.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The item or subject of a row.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, button text below 48px, tags.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Who and where under an entry; helper text.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Timestamps, IDs, quantities, dates: anything a person compares or copies. Tabular figures.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: Counts in summary tiles and the day counter.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and the timestamp burned onto photos.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related items: tag to tag, label to input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside tags and compact rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards and sections on a phone.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top of a screen above its title.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Report header and footer spacing.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, the mark's cells, progress segments.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, photos. The largest radius in the system.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable. Site hands are dusty or gloved.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Height of a list row (exception, task, item).

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Bottom action bar on phones.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and menus only. Cards use `line`, not shadow.
